title: Terminal freeze: 28/40 consecutive identical 'full sim state' hashes
detail: Manifest claims per-tick 'full sim state' hashes, yet final 28 (lose) and 40 (win) ticks hash identically, so hashed state excludes clock/animation. These tails verify nothing beyond first frozen tick; clock-freeze regressions in terminal state go undetected.
recommended_fix: Confirm terminal freeze is intended. If sim should halt at terminal tick, stop ticking; if it keeps running, include tick/time in hashed state so per-tick hashes remain distinct.

evidence:

+460 b25974f8de6c0ea9
diff --git a/goldens/health_lose/05000ms.png b/goldens/health_lose/05000ms.png

detail: State freezes at tick 453 (22.65s), yet screenshots exist only at 21000ms and 23000ms — 1.65s before and ~350ms after the transition. The exact moment the golden guards is never visually captured.
recommended_fix: Add a screenshot at the transition tick (e.g., 22650ms) so the visual golden verifies the lose-state change itself, not only pre- and post-freeze frames.

title: health_win: 75.5s screenshot gap leaves most of 152s demo unverified
evidence:
+ticks 3040
diff --git a/goldens/health_win/30000ms.png b/goldens/health_win/30000ms.png
diff --git a/goldens/health_win/75000ms.png b/goldens/health_win/75000ms.png
diff --git a/goldens/health_win/150500ms.png b/goldens/health_win/150500ms.png
detail: 152s demo has screenshots only at 30s, 75s, 150.5s. The 75.5s stretch between 75s and 150.5s — presumably where health declines toward the win threshold — has no visual golden.
recommended_fix: Add intermediate screenshots during the uncovered span (e.g., 100s and 130s) so health-display regressions mid-run are caught by the visual golden.

title: Patch elides 2188 tick-hash lines; health_win golden body unverifiable from this diff
evidence: +[... 2188 tick-hash lines elided by Perkins — monotone per-tick hash list ...]
detail: Ticks 293–2480 absent from the patch, so integrity and uniqueness of the golden body cannot be checked here. Annotation calls hashes 'monotone', which FNV-1a-64 output over evolving state cannot be.
recommended_fix: Regenerate patch without elision for review, and correct the 'monotone' description; validate the elided block separately (ordering, uniqueness, count) before merging.
